newsitem.title: JORDAN: Arafat in Jordan to see King Hussein.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Jordan to see King Hussein.

text.p: Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat arrived in Amman on Tuesday on a courtesy visit to see King Hussein of Jordan, who underwent minor knee surgery three days ago.
Witnesses said Arafat was met on arrival by Crown Prince Hassan, Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti, and a bedouin guard of honour.
Arafat had been due to visit on Monday but officials said bad weather forced a postponement.
King Hussein had minor surgery on Saturday on both his knees. One was to remove a cartilage and another to repair damage caused during his pilgrimage to Mecca last Thursday.

Tuesday's meeting will be the first between Arafat and King Hussein since the Jordanian monarch flew to Gaza and Tel Aviv two weeks ago to help break a deadlock in Palestinian-Israeli talks on the West Bank town of Hebron.
The two sides finally agreed after months of delay on details of an Israeli troop withdrawal from 80 percent of Hebron and a timetable for further redeployment from the West Bank.
